title: Wayfire
description: Travel between campfires by feeding a magical fire network.
body:
# Wayfire

Wayfire adds a lightweight campfire fast-travel system to Minecraft.

Craft a Wayfire Compass and bind lit campfires into a magical network.

## Features

- Craftable Wayfire Compass
- Create Wayfires at lit campfires
- Name Wayfires with Name Tags
- Remove Wayfires using an axe
- Coal-powered travel
- Lit campfire requirement
- Persistent save data
- Smoke and sound travel effects
- Wayfire destination GUI

## How To Use

1. Craft a Wayfire Compass
2. Sneak + Right Click a campfire with the compass
3. Name the Wayfire with a Name Tag (optional)
4. Create additional Wayfires
5. Right Click a Wayfire to open the network
6. Spend 1 Coal to travel

## Alpha Notice

Currently tested in singleplayer.
Multiplayer support is planned for a future update.
